name: Back squat every 2:00 x 5 sets of 6 @ 185 lb
notes: Done on 16 Nov evening (recorded 02:56 UTC 17 Nov). Every 2:00, 6 back squats at 185 lb, same weight all sets; the athlete is ~90% sure every set was 6, and the motion counts 6 in every set.
Crown turned at the start of the next set (the 2:00 mark), so each part = set + rest. Bar on the back 19-27 s per set; reps every 2.5-2.8 s, slowing a little each set.
At 185 lb the forearm tips further at the bottom of each squat than with a light bar (gravity x down to ~0.46): a bar-on-back test needs a lower threshold than the 0.6 used for light squats.
